parameters.name: Solicit
parameters.description: The total number of SOLICIT messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Advertise
parameters.description: The total number of ADVERTISE messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Request
parameters.description: The total number of REQUEST messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: The total number of CONFIRM messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Renew
parameters.description: The total number of RENEW messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Rebind
parameters.description: The total number of REBIND messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Reply
parameters.description: The total number of REPLY messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The total number of RELEASE packets received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Decline
parameters.description: The total number of INFORM messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: Reconfigure
parameters.description: The total number of RECONFIGURE messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: InformationRequest
parameters.description: The total number of INFORMATION-REQUEST messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: RelayForward
parameters.description: The total number of RELAY-FORW messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: RelayReply
parameters.description: The total number of RELAY-REPL messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8415|Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6}}.

parameters.name: DiscardedPackets
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP packets discarded by the server. Packets can be discarded due to illegal message format and content, incorrect received bytes, etc.

parameters.name: TransmitFailure
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP messages that failed to transmit.

object.description: Provide statistics for the embedded DHCPv6 Server.
